convention: Every number a turn settles comes from a mechanic this game names, run by `akasha game settle --game game/harem-hotel --turn <n> --mechanic <address> --reading <json> --dice 2d10`. The command rolls the dice itself from the hash of the row before, runs the mechanic, appends the run to mechanicRuns and answers the numbers, so no roll is asked for twice and none is thumbed. A contested action is `game-mechanic/attack-resolution`, taking attackPower, defense, baseDamage, gate, intent and bonuses; the derived stats it is handed are each a mechanic of their own. The numbers fix the MAGNITUDE; the OUTCOME is adjudicated against the declared mechanics and the floor design (e.g. a mirror construct returns spent force to the attacker rather than taking it). Loop-dark: a run is the GM's to read, never a client payload.
